purpose: Validation-only attribution of weak prior/context conditioning; not deployment calibration or formal-test checkpoint selection

same_host_replication.name: same_host_control
same_host_replication.reason: Repeat the unmodified condition on aigc29 alongside the three prespecified ablations because the original reference ran on aigc24

constraints: No optimizer or checkpoint writes; no formal rollout labels as input
Keep the same frozen models, samples, task set, seed, batch size and execution protocol
Compare sample-weighted H15 and H50 flow and report both; do not substitute historical batch-mean aggregation
Scaling improvement supports attenuation as a hypothesis; scaling degradation alone does not prove ZTE lacks information because the model was not trained at that scale
No success-rate or stable-gain claim from offline validation
